name: openbb_equity_share_statistics
description:
Share statistics for one stock (shares outstanding, float, short interest, ownership) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.ownership.share_statistics).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, intrinio, yfinance; default yfinance).
Share count over time: yf_shares_outstanding; holders: yf_major_holders. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
